attempts.surface: Unified conversation composer and sent-message history UI via Electron CDP + Playwright

actual_preconditions.fixture: 35 tiny round-owned text files; task conversation created for this test

attempts.input: Sent first message with attachments count-01 through count-20 and second message with count-21 through count-35; both prompts requested a fixed text-only response.
actual_steps: In a new round-owned task, attached count-01.txt through count-20.txt and sent a harmless fixed-response request in Standard/low mode.
Observed the first user message with its 20 attachments and the assistant response.
In the next pending message, attached count-21.txt through count-35.txt; the UI showed exactly 15 cards.
Sent a second harmless fixed-response request; the second user message retained all 15 attachments.
No attachments were removed from message history; the round-owned task remains for review.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for each assistant fixed-text response and read back the corresponding sent user-message attachment state.

checkpoints.expected: 按当前待发送轮次计数
checkpoints.observed: After the first sent turn carried 20 attachments, the next turn’s pending composer contained exactly the 15 new attachments count-21.txt through count-35.txt.
Both turns completed with 20 and 15 attachments respectively (35 total across the conversation); the second turn accepted all 15, showing the current-turn set was not limited by the earlier 20.

attempts.observed_result: The first sent round held 20 round-owned attachments; the next turn accepted a fresh 15 and sent them as a second message. All 35 attachments appeared across the two turns without applying the prior turn count to the new pending turn.
attempts.notes: Only the round-owned test conversation and harmless fixture files were used. No real IM or external message was sent. The conversation is intentionally retained as round-owned test evidence; pending bilateral review.

remaining: The round-owned conversation and its 20/15 attached fixture references remain in task history for review. Source fixtures remain in the task fixture folder.
